summary: All 3 bug fixes verified working correctly. Bug 1: SC Order auto-created when marking in_progress MO as subcontract (tested with WO-000005 -> JW-000012). Bug 2: JW orders table shows item names alongside part numbers. Bug 3: MO # column added to JW orders table.
passed_tests: Bug 1: PUT /api/work-orders/{id} with is_subcontract=true creates SC Order for in_progress MO
Bug 1: SC Order (JW-000012) auto-created when marking WO-000005 as subcontract
Bug 1: JW orders count increased from 11 to 12 after marking MO as SC
Bug 2: GET /api/job-work/orders returns item details (part_number, name) in lines
Bug 2: JW orders table Items column shows 'RM-002 Aluminum Bar 25mm' format
Bug 3: GET /api/job-work/orders returns mo_number field for orders with reference_wo_id
Bug 3: JW orders table has 'MO #' column header
Bug 3: MO # column shows linked MO numbers (e.g., WO-000005, MO-000012)
Subcontracted MOs (is_subcontract=true) do NOT show Job Card button

Subcontracted MOs show 'SC' badge and 'Sub-Contract' label in Manufacturing Orders page
seed_data_creation: Marked WO-000005 as subcontract which created JW-000012 SC Order
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 bug fixes verified: (1) SC Order creation when marking in_progress MO as SC - working (tested with WO-000005 -> JW-000012), (2) JW orders table shows item names - working (e.g., 'RM-002 Aluminum Bar 25mm'), (3) MO # column in JW orders table - working. Subcontracted MOs correctly hide Job Card/Complete buttons. Test data: WO-000005 (now subcontracted, linked to JW-000012).
